title: Influencer Outreach & Affiliate Partnership Specialist +
description:
**Job Type:** Remote | Part-Time / Full-Time

**Salary:** $4 USD per hour 

**Performance Bonus:** $5 USD for every successfully activated affiliate/partner

**Opportunity:** Long-term position with growth potential



## About the Role



We're looking for an experienced **Influencer Outreach & Affiliate Partnership Specialist** to help us recruit influencers, content creators, and affiliates to promote our online educational products.



Our business focuses on humanoid robotics investing so we will want to find content creators and affiliates in the artificial intelligence, cryptocurrency, stocks, and emerging investment opportunities, robotics and AI space.



We offer a partnership program where influencers can earn commissions by promoting our educational products to their audiences.



Your job is to find relevant influencers, reach out through
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X/Twitter, and other platforms, and turn interested creators into active, revenue-generating partners.



This is a HIGH-VOLUME OUTREACH role. We want someone who can consistently find qualified prospects, conduct outreach at scale, follow up, and recruit partners.



## Compensation & Performance Bonuses



Base Pay: $4 USD per hour



Performance Bonus: $5 USD per Activated Partner



An activated partner means:



They have joined and completed onboarding for our partnership program.

They have started actively promoting our product by publishing qualifying promotional content or generating a verified sale.



Simply getting someone to sign up does NOT count as activation.



There is no fixed cap on activation bonuses. The more qualifying partners you activate, the more you can earn.



Example:



20 activated partners = $100 bonus

50 activated partners = $250 bonus

100 activated partners = $500 bonus



Bonuses are paid in addition to your regular hourly compensation, after activation has been verified.



Key Responsibilities



1. Influencer Research & Lead Generation



* Find relevant influencers on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X/Twitter, and other social media platforms.

* Target creators in investing, stocks, cryptocurrency, AI, robotics, personal finance, and technology or anything relevant to ou r niche

* Identify micro-influencers, mid-sized creators, and larger influencers with engaged audiences.

* Research influencer engagement, audience quality, and potential partnership fit.

* Find publicly available business
s and appropriate contact channels.

* Build and maintain a database of qualified influencer prospects.



2. High-Volume
 & DM Outreach



* Conduct high-volume, personalized outreach through
, Instagram DMs, TikTok messages, X/Twitter, and other approved channels.

* Introduce influencers to our affiliate and partnership program.

* Write compelling outreach messages that generate positive responses.

* Use approved automation tools, templates, and outreach systems to work efficiently.

* Experiment with different messaging angles and subject lines.

* Follow up consistently with interested or unanswered prospects.

* Track conversations and maintain organized outreach records.



We are looking for someone with actual high-volume outreach experience—not someone who only sends a handful of messages per day.



### 3. Affiliate Recruitment & Activation



Your responsibility doesn't end when someone signs up.



We want partners who actually start promoting our products.



You will:



* Explain our affiliate program and partnership benefits.

* Answer influencer questions about commissions and promotions.

* Help interested creators complete onboarding.

* Provide partners with approved promotional resources.

* Encourage onboarded partners to publish their first promotional content.

* Follow up with partners who signed up but haven't started promoting.

* Track partner activation and ensure every qualifying activation is recorded.



4. Outreach Tracking & Reporting



* Track the number of influencers researched and contacted.

* Record outreach messages, follow-ups, and responses.

* Monitor positive response rates.

* Track affiliate sign-ups and completed onboarding.

* Track **activated affiliates**, not just registrations.

* Provide daily updates and weekly performance reports.

* Identify successful outreach messages and opportunities for improvement.



## MUST-HAVE Requirements



* Previous experience with influencer outreach, cold
, affiliate recruitment, or high-volume DM outreach.

* Proven ability to handle outreach campaigns involving hundreds or thousands of prospects.

* Excellent written English.

* Experience finding influencers and business contact information.

* Familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and X/Twitter.

* Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills.

* Experience using Google Sheets, CRM systems, and outreach tools.

* Ability to work independently and meet performance targets.

* Organized, detail-oriented, and results-driven.



## Strongly Preferred



* Experience recruiting affiliates or influencers for digital products.

* Experience promoting online courses or educational products.

* Knowledge of stocks, cryptocurrency, artificial intelligence, or investing.

* Experience with outreach tools such as Instantly, Smartlead, Apollo, Hunter, or similar platforms.

* Experience improving cold outreach response rates.

* Experience onboarding and activating affiliates.



## Performance Expectations



We're looking for someone who can consistently generate qualified opportunities and actual partnerships.



Initial targets include:



* Researching and qualifying 50–100 influencer prospects per working day.

* Conducting consistent high-volume outreach through approved channels.

* Following up with prospects professionally.

* Moving interested influencers through the partnership onboarding process.

* Activating new affiliates who begin promoting our products.

* Maintaining accurate daily reporting.



**Your success will be measured primarily by the number and quality of affiliates you activate—not simply how many messages you send.**



## How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions:



1. **Outreach Experience:** Describe your experience with influencer outreach, cold
s, or social media DMs.



2. **Previous Results:** How many outreach messages have you handled per day? How many partnerships or affiliates have you successfully recruited?



3. **Outreach Tools:** Which software and tools have you used for lead generation,
 outreach, automation, and tracking?



4. **Sample Message:** Write a short Instagram DM inviting a finance or investing influencer to join our humanoid robotics investing course affiliate program.



5. **Your Strategy:** If you were tasked with finding and reaching 500 qualified influencers, how would you approach it?



6. **Availability:** How many hours per week can you work, and what is your expected hourly rate within our $4 USD range?



**IMPORTANT:** Start your application with the words **"AFFILIATE OUTREACH PRO"** so we know you've read the full job description.



We're looking for a reliable, resourceful, and results-oriented team member who can help us scale our influencer partnership program long-term.



**The better you perform, the more you can earn through activation bonuses!**

title: Experienced Mental Health Virtual Assistant
description:
NOW HIRING: Experienced Mental Health Virtual Assistant

Position: Medical Virtual Assistant | Medical Billing & Credentialing Specialist



Company: Stonebridge Mental Health  

Location: Remote – Philippines  

Employment Type: Full-Time  

Schedule:U.S. Central Standard/Daylight Time (Minnesota business hours)  

Industry: Mental Health / Psychiatry / Healthcare



About Our Practice



Stonebridge Mental Health is a psychiatric and mental health practice based in Minnesota, USA. We are seeking a highly experienced, organized, reliable, and proactive Medical Virtual Assistant to manage the daily administrative and operational functions of our practice.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and help ensure our practice operates efficiently while our psychiatric provider focuses on patient care.



This is not an entry-level position. Previous U.S. healthcare experience, particularly in mental health or psychiatry, is strongly preferred.



Key Responsibilities



1. Insurance Verification & Prior Authorizations

- Verify patients' insurance eligibility and active coverage before appointments.

- Confirm mental health benefits, copays, deductibles, coinsurance, and patient responsibility.

- Verify whether providers are in-network.

- Obtain prior authorizations when required.

- Identify insurance coverage issues and communicate them promptly.

- Maintain accurate insurance information in the EHR.



2. Medical Billing & Claims Management

- Prepare, review, and submit medical claims electronically.

- Ensure accurate CPT and ICD-10 coding based on provider documentation.

- Review claims for errors before submission.

- Monitor claim status and follow up on unpaid, rejected, or denied claims.

- Correct and resubmit claims when appropriate.

- Review Explanation of Benefits (EOB) and Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA).

- Post insurance payments and patient payments.

- Manage accounts receivable (A/R) and outstanding balances.

- Assist with payment reconciliation and billing reports.

- Follow up with insurance companies to resolve billing issues.



3. Insurance Credentialing & Provider Enrollment

- Complete and submit insurance credentialing applications.

- Manage provider enrollment with commercial insurance, Medicare, and Medicaid.

- Maintain and update CAQH profiles.

- Follow up on pending applications and contracts.

- Assist with recredentialing and payer roster updates.

- Track effective dates, credentialing deadlines, and network participation.

- Communicate with insurance representatives to resolve enrollment issues.



4. Electronic Health Records (EHR) Management

- Experience using U.S. healthcare EHR systems.

- Familiarity with AdvancedMD, SimplePractice, Office Ally, or similar systems is preferred.

- Maintain accurate patient demographic and insurance information.

- Upload, organize, and manage patient documents.

- Prepare patient charts before appointments.

- Track incomplete administrative documentation.

- Process medical records requests with proper authorization.

- Ensure patient information is handled securely and confidentially.



5. Patient Scheduling & Communication

- Answer incoming calls professionally.

- Return missed calls and voi
s promptly.

- Schedule new patient evaluations and follow-up appointments.

- Manage appointment confirmations, cancellations, and rescheduling.

- Send appointment reminders and intake paperwork.

- Respond to patient
s and portal messages.

- Assist patients with telehealth access and scheduling concerns.

- Maintain an organized provider calendar.

- Follow up with patients who miss appointments.



6. Referrals, Lab Orders & Care Coordination

- Process incoming and outgoing referrals.

- Send provider-approved lab orders to appropriate laboratories.

- Follow up on pending referrals and outstanding laboratory results.

- Request medical records from referring providers.

- Coordinate communication with primary care providers, specialists, pharmacies, and other healthcare professionals.

- Track outstanding administrative tasks and follow up until completed.

- Route clinical questions, urgent concerns, medication requests, and abnormal results to the provider promptly.



**7. Daily Practice Operations**

- Manage the practice's
 inbox and telephone communications.

- Maintain organized administrative workflows.

- Monitor outstanding tasks and deadlines.

- Track new patient inquiries and referral sources.

- Follow up on incomplete intake forms and required documents.

- Maintain spreadsheets and operational tracking systems.

- Assist with insurance audits and documentation requests.

- Prepare weekly reports on appointments, claims, collections, denials, and pending tasks.

- Identify operational problems and recommend improvements.

- Support additional administrative duties as needed.



 Required Qualifications



- Minimum 2 years of experience as a U.S. Medical Virtual Assistant, Medical Biller, or Healthcare Administrative Assistant.

- Strong experience with U.S. insurance eligibility verification and benefits.

- Hands-on experience submitting claims and resolving denials.

- Knowledge of insurance credentialing and CAQH.

- Experience using an electronic health record system.

- Familiarity with CPT codes, ICD-10 codes, and healthcare billing terminology.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong telephone etiquette and customer service skills.

- Knowledge of HIPAA privacy and confidentiality requirements.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to multitask and work independently.

- Reliable high-speed internet, computer, and quiet workspace.

- Ability to work during U.S. Central Time business hours.



 Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with psychiatric or mental health providers.

- Familiarity with psychiatric billing codes such as 90792, 99213, 99214, 99215, and psychotherapy add-on codes.

- Experience with Minnesota Medicaid, Medicare, Optum/UnitedHealthcare, Medica, Aetna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and other commercial payers.

- Experience with AdvancedMD and Office Ally.

- Experience managing the administrative operations of a solo-provider medical practice.

- Experience with insurance appeals, aging reports, and revenue cycle management.

- Experience supporting telehealth practices.



 What We Are Looking For



We need someone who is **proactive, dependable, detail-oriented, and capable of managing the administrative side of a growing mental health practice with minimal supervision.**



The ideal candidate does not simply wait for instructions but identifies outstanding tasks, follows through on responsibilities, and communicates regularly.



 How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your updated resume.

2. A brief description of your U.S. healthcare experience.

3. The EHR systems you have used.

4. Your experience with insurance verification, medical billing, and credentialing.

5. Your experience working with mental health or psychiatric practices.

6. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

7. Your availability to work U.S. Central Time hours.



Important: Please begin your application with the words "Stonebridge VA" so we know you have read the entire job description.



We are looking for a long-term team member who can grow with our practice.

title: Part-Time B2B Sales & Appointment Setter — US Beauty Wholesale Accounts
description:
Nuovaderm Beauty is seeking an experienced Philippines-based B2B sales and appointment-setting contractor to help build recurring wholesale relationships with US beauty businesses.



We are a US-based authorized Ekai distributor supplying authentic Dr. Pen devices, replacement cartridges and related accessories. We work directly with Ekai, and redacted direct-sourcing documentation is available.



Our customers and prospects include esthetics schools, beauty academies, independent estheticians, spas, salons, educators, beauty-supply stores and specialty retailers.



Our objective is to become a dependable primary or backup US supplier for these businesses. We currently carry Dr. Pen M8S inventory, but this role is not limited to selling one model. You will discover which models, cartridges and accessories each business needs. Other authentic Ekai/Dr. Pen products may be sourced subject to confirmed availability and approved order terms.



PAY AND OPPORTUNITY

Pay is $12–$15 USD per hour, depending on demonstrated experience, starting at approximately eight hours per week.



This role begins with a two-week paid trial, including an initial two-hour paid checkpoint. At that checkpoint, we will review preparation, outreach execution and documentation before authorizing further hours. All authorized time worked will be paid.



Our goal is to find someone for a consistent, ongoing working relationship. A successful trial may lead to regular weekly work and increased hours as the business grows.



Performance bonuses are available for agreed, measurable results. Bonus amounts and qualification criteria will be agreed in writing before the applicable work begins.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Research and verify relevant US business prospects.

• Work from initial prospect lists and existing outreach records.

• Make professional outbound calls during agreed US business hours.

• Reach owners, educators and purchasing decision-makers.

• Discover current device models, cartridge configurations and accessory needs.

• Understand whether products are used internally, resold or included in student kits.

• Ask about quantities per order and purchasing frequency.

• Learn about supplier concerns, including authenticity, availability, lead time, pricing and support.

• Ask about current or target pricing when appropriate, including whether shipping is included.

• Introduce Nuovaderm as a potential primary or backup supplier.

• Present M8S when it fits the prospect’s needs.

• Document demand for other models without promising unconfirmed sourcing.

• Schedule qualified conversations with the founder, Mercy Arrey.

• Send approved follow-ups.

• Maintain accurate call records, prospect notes and next actions.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

• Demonstrated B2B cold-calling, appointment-setting or wholesale-sales experience.

• Experience speaking with US business owners and purchasing decision-makers.

• Strong discovery, listening and objection-handling skills.

• Clear, professional, conversational spoken English and strong written English.

• Reliable availability during agreed US business hours, which will generally mean evening or night work in the Philippines.

• Accurate recordkeeping and consistent follow-up.

• Reliable internet, a suitable headset and a quiet calling environment.

• Ability to follow approved pricing and product information.



Beauty, esthetics, spa, salon, education, professional-device or wholesale experience is strongly preferred.



COMMUNICATION STANDARD

You must be able to hold natural conversations with US business owners, understand their answers, ask relevant follow-up questions and explain next steps clearly.



Finalists will demonstrate these skills in a live interview and sales role-play. We assess clarity, listening and effectiveness rather than accent or nationality.



WHAT NUOVADERM PROVIDES

• Target-business criteria and initial prospect lists.

• Approved product and authenticity information.

• Call, voi
 and follow-up guidance.

• Pricing boundaries and approved answers to common questions.

• A prospect and activity tracker.

• Founder support for qualified purchasing conversations.

• Guidance on confirmed availability and sourcing.



WORKING BOUNDARIES

This is individualized business outreach, not mass
 or automated-spam work.



Do not make medical or regulatory claims, invent product facts, promise unconfirmed availability, offer unauthorized discounts or agree to exclusivity.



Keep accurate records and respect requests not to be contacted.



HOW PERFORMANCE IS REVIEWED

We review verified prospect research, outreach execution, decision-makers reached, meaningful conversations, purchasing needs identified, qualified appointments attended, follow-up quality and resulting buying opportunities.



A qualified appointment involves a legitimate US business, an appropriate decision-maker or authorized representative, a relevant purchasing need and genuine agreement to discuss Nuovaderm as a supplier.



We do not require a sale within the initial two-hour checkpoint.



HOW TO APPLY

Please answer the application questions below with specific examples from your own experience. A polished résumé alone is not sufficient. Copy each question into your application and answer it.



1. Describe one recent B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting assignment. What did you sell, whom did you call, what did you personally handle and what results followed?

2. What experience do you have reaching US business owners or purchasing decision-makers? Include any beauty, spa, school, device or wholesale experience.

3. Which US business hours can you consistently cover? State the time zone and corresponding Philippine hours.

4. How would you divide eight working hours among preparation, prospect research, calling, documentation and follow-up?

5. A prospect says: “We already have a supplier, we use A6S, and your price is higher.” How would you continue the conversation?

6. How do you document calls and organize follow-ups without contacting prospects excessively?

7. Confirm that you accept the $12–$15/hour range, initial eight-hour weekly schedule, two-week paid trial, two-hour paid checkpoint and live interview/role-play.



Finalists will complete a live interview and the same sales role-play. Any actual prospecting assignment will be paid and begin only after a paid engagement is agreed.

title: Industrial Product Designer / 3D CAD Specialist – Consumer Product Development
description:
Industrial Product Designer / 3D CAD Specialist – Consumer Product Development



Job Type: Project-Based / Freelance  

Location: Remote  

Compensation: Negotiable based on experience and project scope



About the Project



I'm developing a premium, luxury golf accessory that I plan to manufacture and sell commercially.



I have already created detailed photorealistic product renderings showing the intended design from multiple angles. I am now looking for an experienced **industrial designer or mechanical CAD specialist** who can transform these renderings into an accurate, professional, and manufacturable 3D CAD model.



This is a real product development project, not simply a 3D rendering exercise.



The product consists primarily of a sculpted hardwood body, custom brass components, and an integrated cleaning brush.



What You'll Be Doing



- Study reference renderings and translate the design into accurate 3D CAD geometry.

- Reconcile inconsistencies between different reference views.

- Preserve the original design's appearance, proportions, curvature, and detailed craftsmanship.

- Develop realistic dimensions, cross-sections, and component relationships.

- Model a sculpted wooden body with curved surfaces and carefully beveled edges.

- Design mounting provisions for brass components, fasteners, and brush bristles.

- Identify potential manufacturing challenges and recommend practical solutions.

- Prepare editable CAD files and professional technical drawings for prototyping and eventual manufacturing.



Required Qualifications



- Strong experience with SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or comparable professional CAD software.

- Experience with industrial design, mechanical design, or physical consumer product development.

- Strong ability to create complex curved surfaces, sculpted bodies, and precise solid models.

- Understanding of materials, mechanical connections, assembly methods, and manufacturing constraints.

- Ability to translate product images and concept renderings into physically realistic 3D models.

- Attention to detail and the ability to preserve the aesthetics of an existing design.



**Experience with CNC machining, woodworking, metal components, or luxury consumer products is a major plus.**



Project Deliverables



The project will be divided into two stages.



Stage 1 — Exterior Design and 3D Modeling



- Develop a precise 3D model from the provided reference images.

- Establish consistent dimensions and geometry.

- Reproduce the original sculpted shape and overall appearance as closely as practical.

- Provide multiple views of the model for review.

- Make agreed-upon revisions until the exterior design is approved.

- Deliver the editable native CAD model and STEP file.



Stage 2 — Detailed Engineering and Manufacturing Preparation**



- Finalize individual component geometry and mounting details.

- Develop the product assembly.

- Produce dimensioned engineering drawings and cross-sections.

- Prepare native CAD, STEP, and STL files.

- Identify any unresolved manufacturing or prototyping requirements.



The initial contract will focus on Stage 1. Stage 2 may be awarded after satisfactory completion of the first stage.



Important Design Requirement



I am very particular about preserving the original product's appearance.



I do not want someone who will simplify the design into a generic shape just because it is easier to model.



The ideal candidate can balance aesthetics, mechanical accuracy, and manufacturability.



I will provide all available reference images, preliminary dimensions, and previous design notes.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A portfolio showing **3D CAD models of actual physical products** you have designed, preferably including curved or sculpted surfaces.

2. Which CAD software you use and your level of experience with it.

3. Examples of any products you've designed that were successfully prototyped or manufactured.

4. Your estimated price and timeline for Stage 1.

5. A brief explanation of how you would approach converting product renderings into accurate, manufacturable CAD geometry.



Please begin your application with the words "Golf Product CAD" so I know you've read the full description.**



I'm looking for someone who can deliver high-quality work and potentially collaborate on additional product development projects in the future.

Join Our Team as a Marketing & Content Specialist!



Are you a creative marketing professional who longs to build compelling, multi-channel growth campaigns while remaining fully grounded in the Catholic vision of the human person?



The CURA Centre For Flourishing is a Canadian Catholic counselling firm. We bridge the gap between sound, evidence-based psychological care and the richness of the Catholic intellectual tradition. We help individuals and families find authentic healing, freedom, and human flourishing—and we need a strategic, hands-on marketer to help us share that mission with the world. We are seeking a dedicated part time Marketing & Content Specialist based out of the Philipines to join our growing team. 



Who Thrives at CURA?

We are looking for a marketing professional who is creative, analytical, deeply Catholic, self-motivated, and collaborative. You excel at taking a brand’s vision and converting it into multi-media content, optimized online listings, and engaged digital communities.



Why Work with CURA?

Mission-Aligned Culture: Work in a supportive, faith-filled environment where your work directly helps connect people to life-changing Catholic mental health care.

Creative Freedom & Ownership: Take the lead on launching our social media presence, renovating key website pages, and managing our content strategy from start to finish.

Flexible & Remote-Friendly: Enjoy schedule autonomy with hybrid/remote flexibility and clear goals.

Collaborative Environment: Work directly with leadership in an atmosphere that values clear communication, professional growth, and personal well-being.



Qualifications & Expectations

Catholic Fidelity: A strong personal alignment with the mission of CURA and a wholehearted respect for the teachings and tradition of the Catholic Church. (The successful candidate does not have to be Catholic.)

Digital Marketing Expertise: Proficiency with
 marketing platforms (Mailchimp), web management (Squarespace), SEO best practices, and local listing management (Google Business Profile).

Multimedia Skills: Hands-on experience with video editing (for YouTube and website embeds), social media account creation/management, and basic graphic/asset organization.

Theoretical Literacy: Basic knowledge of mental health, psychological principles, inner healing, and therapy concepts to accurately reflect CURA's mission in messaging and educational content.

Analytical Mindset: Familiarity with tracking metrics, setting up lead conversion pipelines, and reporting on channel performance.

Adaptability & Team Spirit: Comfortable working in a agile, small-business environment where initiative and general administrative flexibility are highly valued.



Key Responsibilities

Digital & Social Media Strategy: Establish and manage CURA’s YouTube, social media, and podcast presence; develop and execute content calendars to build our
 audience.

 Campaigns: Design and send campaigns via Mailchimp.

Squarespace Website Management: Renovate and expand our website at 

Video Editing: Edit, upload, publish, and embed YouTube videos.

SEO & Local Listings: Optimize Google Business Profiles, directory listings, and public-facing content to drive local search traffic.

Tracking & Asset Management: Implement lead-source and conversion tracking; organize digital brand assets and content calendars.

General Administrative Support: Collaborate directly with the Director on general administrative tasks and special projects as a key member of a small team.



How to Apply

Submit your resume, portfolio/samples of work, cover letter, and a video introduction outlining your alignment with CURA’s mission and vision (following a careful review of our website) to 



Note on the salary and desired hours per week:

We’re not looking for a body to fill a position. We’re looking for YOU (a dynamic Catholic passionate about marketing a mission of mental health) to collaborate with us in creative ways. Full time applicants are welcome to apply.

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (Python/Django)
description:
Company: US-Based SaaS Startup

Position: Full-Time | 40 Hours/Week | Long-Term

Bonus: 13th-Month Bonus

Schedule: Flexible – Work Normal Philippine Daytime Hours (No Overnight US Shift)



**About the Opportunity**



We're a US-based software company building a comprehensive Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform that connects accounting, customer relationships, operations, workflows, and other essential business functions into one integrated system. After 18 months of development, we're looking for our first external software engineer to help complete our MVP, improve existing functionality, and prepare the product for launch. You'll work directly with a technical founder who leads the overall product vision and architecture, while taking ownership of meaningful development work. We're looking for someone who doesn't just write code to make something work, but thinks critically about how to build scalable, flexible, and maintainable systems that can evolve as the product grows.



**What You'll Do**



• Full-Stack Development: Build and improve features across our Django backend, PostgreSQL database, and HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontend.

• Scalable System Design: Develop reusable, configurable, and extensible solutions rather than relying on hardcoded logic or short-term workarounds.

• Feature Ownership: Independently take features from requirements through implementation, testing, and completion.

• Architecture & Problem-Solving: Understand how different modules interact, anticipate edge cases, and recommend thoughtful technical solutions.

• DevOps & Infrastructure: Assist with AWS deployments, environment configuration, CI/CD processes, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.

• Quality & Performance: Debug complex issues, optimize queries and application performance, write automated tests, and improve security and reliability.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with the founder to evaluate approaches, identify improvements, and help prepare the platform for production.



**Our Tech Stack**



• Backend: Python, Django

• Database: PostgreSQL

• Frontend: HTML, CSS, Vanilla JavaScript

• Testing: pytest

• Background Tasks: Celery, Redis

• Infrastructure & DevOps: AWS, Git, CI/CD, deployment and monitoring tools

• Other: REST APIs, third-party integrations



**What We're Looking For**



• 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on Python/Django expertise.

• Strong knowledge of Django architecture, PostgreSQL, relational database design, and query optimization.

• Comfortable building interactive interfaces using HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.

• Experience designing scalable, dynamic, and maintainable systems with reusable components and configurable business logic.

• Ability to understand and extend existing complex codebases without introducing unnecessary complexity or technical debt.

• Working knowledge of DevOps fundamentals, cloud deployments, and production application troubleshooting.

• Strong debugging, problem-solving, testing, and performance optimization skills.

• Ability to work independently, take ownership, and make sound technical decisions with minimal supervision.

• Proactive communication, attention to detail, and good written and spoken English.



**Nice to Have**



• Experience building ERP, CRM, SaaS, or other business management platforms.

• Experience with AG Grid, particularly advanced data tables, filtering, editing, and dynamic data-driven interfaces.

• Experience with Celery, Redis, background processing, and API integrations.

• Stronger AWS, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, or application monitoring experience.

• Experience helping bring early-stage software products into production.



**Why Join Us**



• Meaningful Ownership: Take responsibility for important features and contribute to how the product is built.

• Work With a Technical Founder: Collaborate directly with someone who understands software development and values thoughtful engineering.

• Interesting Technical Challenges: Build interconnected systems with complex business workflows, dynamic interfaces, and evolving requirements.

• Flexible Working Hours: Work during normal Philippine daytime hours. No overnight US shift required.

• Long-Term Growth: Join early and have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities as the product and engineering team expand.



**How to Apply**



1. Your resume/CV and a brief overview of your Python/Django experience.

2. Your GitHub, portfolio, or examples of relevant projects, if available.

3. A brief example of a complex feature or system you independently designed or developed. How did you make it scalable, flexible, or maintainable rather than relying on hardcoded solutions?

4. Your expected monthly salary (USD) and earliest availability.



We're looking for a thoughtful, dependable engineer who takes pride in building quality software, solves problems independently, and thinks beyond simply completing assigned tasks. If you enjoy building well-designed systems and want to make a meaningful impact on a growing software product, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Video Editing_Cut 200 exercise loops from raw 4K gym footage (vertical, Photoshop set extension)
description:
Description

I run a fitness app and need short exercise demo loops cut from raw gym footage. This is repetitive production work, not creative editing. Everything is spelled out in a one-page guide with an overlay template, before/after examples and finished samples.

Everything you need is here: 

Open "DadUnit Editor Kit" and read "1 START HERE" first. The three finished MP4s in "5 FINISHED SAMPLES" are what a delivered loop looks like. "Sample of what the raw footage looks like" is a raw take.

The footage: long 4K vertical takes on a tripod, one person doing many exercises back to back. Before most sets I say the exercise name out loud.

For each set (about 200 in the first batch, up to 400 total):

• Find where the movement begins and get the exercise name from the audio. No name, flag it.

• Cut 3 clean reps in a row into a seamless loop (usually 8-15 seconds)

• Reframe it on the provided guide overlay so the athlete sits in the right spot

• Build a set extension where needed. Some camera setups were filmed too tight, so you'll extend the background in Photoshop (Generative Expand) and composite the clip over it. One extended background per camera position, reused across every clip from that position.

• Color grade to match the provided reference stills (dark gym, warm skin, high contrast). One preset per camera position.

• Export 1080x1920 MP4, no audio

You need:

• Set extension skills: Photoshop Generative Fill / Generative Expand, plus compositing a video clip over a still background with a feathered mask so no seam shows

• An editor with masking and color tools (Premiere, Resolve, Final Cut or CapCut Pro are all fine)

• Enough disk space and download speed for large 4K files

• To follow a written spec exactly and flag anything you're unsure about instead of guessing

How it works: the first batch of about 200 loops is the test. The budget for it is $400 total, paid as loops are delivered and approved. If the result is good, a second batch of about 200 follows at the same rate.

To bid, send:

1. Confirm you can do the first batch of about 200 loops for $400, and how you want that split into milestones

2. How many loops you can deliver per week

3. Which editing software you use

4. One example of a set extension you've done (a before and after is perfect)

Budget

$400 for the first batch of 200 loops ($2 per loop). This is fixed, not a starting point.

Delivery

30 days.

Attachments (each under Fiverr's 25 MB cap, all in the kit folder on the content drive and in Drive)

• 2 OVERLAY / OVERLAY 1080x1920.png

• 3 EXAMPLES / Curl - BEFORE (as shot).jpg

• 3 EXAMPLES / Curl - AFTER (placed on plate).jpg

• 1 START HERE.pdf

title: AWS MediaLive Engineer Needed for Simple One Laptop Test
description:
The simplest way to prove the remaining limitation is to run a controlled test using one camera-connected laptop for all three source-side functions.



Simplest test



On one laptop:



1. Connect or activate the laptop’s camera.

2. Run OBS and push the captured stream to an AWS MediaLive RTMP input.

3. From that same laptop, use the AWS CLI to submit:

   - Three MediaLive destinations for YouTube,
, and Twitch.

   - One BatchUpdateSchedule request containing an image URI or motion-graphics URL.

4. Start the MediaLive channel.

5. Confirm that:

   - MediaLive receives the camera stream.

   - The overlay appears.

   - MediaLive sends outputs to the three destinations.



The key is using the AWS CLI on the same laptop because the commands, request files, timestamps, and CloudTrail events are easier to preserve than browser activity.



Minimum evidence needed



You need only four coordinated evidence categories:



1. Continuous screen recording



Record the entire operation showing:



- The laptop’s identity and clock.

- The connected camera.

- OBS sending the stream.

- The AWS CLI submitting the destination configuration.

- The AWS CLI submitting the overlay schedule action.

- The resulting overlay and social-platform outputs.



2. OBS log



The OBS log should establish:



- The camera source.

- The MediaLive RTMP endpoint.

- The stream start time.

- The originating computer.



3. CloudTrail records



Preserve the events showing:



- The destination configuration.

- The BatchUpdateSchedule request.

- The overlay URI or URL.

- The IAM principal.

- The source IP address.

- The user agent.

- The channel ID.

- The event timestamps.



4. MediaLive configuration and logs



Export:



- describe-input

- describe-channel

- the channel schedule

- MediaLive encoder logs

- MediaLive as-run logs



These records connect the stream, destinations, and overlay action to the same MediaLive channel.



Strongest simple correlation



The proof chain would be:



1) One identified laptop



2) OBS sends captured content

+ AWS CLI submits three destinations

+ AWS CLI submits overlay URL

3) Same MediaLive channel processes all three inputs



Use the same:



- laptop;

- IAM identity;

- public IP address;

- MediaLive channel ID;

- test name; and

- narrow timestamp window.



A dedicated /32 input-security rule for the laptop’s public IP adds corroboration, although it should not be the only proof.



What this proves



This controlled test would prove that:



> One qualifying source user device can supply the captured digital content, supplemental-content identifier, and plural target identifiers to one MediaLive configuration.







That closes the missing technical limitation for the tested configuration.



Important limitation



The test proves technical operation and capability in the tested configuration. It does not, by itself, prove that Amazon or a particular AWS customer historically operated that configuration. Historical use would require customer logs, AWS records, testimony, source code, or discovery.



Confidence: High that this is the simplest technically reliable method. The best minimal package is a continuous screen recording, OBS log, CloudTrail events, and MediaLive configuration and logs.

About Proper Growth

Proper Growth is the back of house for inventory-heavy consumer brands doing $5M to $50M a

that sell physical products across DTC, Amazon and wholesale.



The role

You'll be the link between our client brands' supply chains and our ops lead. Factories, freight

forwarders, 3PLs and warehouses come to you. You keep every PO, shipment and production

run moving, and you turn it all into the weekly reports and decks our clients rely on. You'll own

all vendor communication and all weekly client materials, so our ops lead can focus on planning

and decisions.



What you'll do

● Vendor communication: Own day-to-day communication with factories, suppliers, freight

forwarders, 3PLs and warehouses across all client brands. Confirm pricing, quantities,

ship dates and specs, and chase anything late.

● Liaison across the supply chain: Keep production, logistics, warehouse and our ops

lead in sync. Get every PO from placement through production, shipping, receiving and

stock on shelf.

● Daily summaries: Turn overnight WeChat, WhatsApp and
 threads into a short

morning summary covering what changed, what's at risk and what needs a decision.

● Weekly client materials: Build and deliver each brand's weekly package: sell-through vs.

forecast, inventory position, open POs and WIP, inbound shipments.

● Deck support: Prepare client decks for weekly calls, monthly closeouts and buy reviews.

● Data hygiene: Keep PO trackers, inventory files and planning sheets current. Reconcile

packing lists, invoices and warehouse receiving reports.



What you need

● 1 to 3+ years in supply chain, production, purchasing or operations coordination.

Consumer goods or apparel preferred.

● Experience working with overseas factories or vendors, and comfort chasing them for

answers.

● Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. Google Slides or PowerPoint for client-ready decks.

● Clear, organized written communication. You can turn a messy vendor thread into three

lines a founder can act on.

● Strong attention to detail across many POs, SKUs and brands at once.

● Availability for some early-morning or evening overlap with Asian vendors.



Nice to have

● Experience with Shopify, ShipHero, NetSuite, Cin7 or similar

● Familiarity with freight terms, customs and landed cost

● Mandarin or Spanish

● Experience using AI tools to draft summaries and reports



How it works

● Start: Contract to start, then full-time once the workload is proven.

● Who you work with: You'll support the Client Operations Manager and our co-founder

across about 8 to 12 client brands.



How to apply

Fill out the application form and include a 45-second video walking us through how you'd track

10 open POs across 3 factories.

Embrace Your Mind and Wellness, LLC is a growing U.S.-based outpatient psychiatric mental health practice serving patients in New York and New Jersey through telehealth and in-person services.



We are seeking an experienced, dependable, detail-oriented Medical Virtual Assistant to provide administrative, documentation, and operational support.



The ideal candidate has previous experience supporting U.S.-based psychiatric providers, behavioral health practices, or multi-provider medical groups.



We are looking for someone who takes initiative, communicates proactively, follows through on assigned responsibilities, and can work independently without requiring constant reminders or supervision.



This is intended to be a long-term opportunity, with potential for increased hours and responsibilities as the practice expands.



Key Responsibilities



1. Patient Scheduling and Intake Coordination



* Follow up on all new patient bookings and inquiries within 24 hours, preferably sooner during scheduled working hours.

* Send intake paperwork, consent forms, appointment instructions, and reminders.

* Review upcoming appointments to identify missing forms, incomplete registrations, or outstanding administrative requirements.

* Follow up with patients regarding incomplete paperwork before appointments.

* Collect and securely upload identification, insurance cards, and required documents into the appropriate EHR.

* Assist with scheduling, rescheduling, cancellations, and appointment confirmations.

* Monitor Zocdoc bookings and coordinate patient intake across practice platforms.

* Maintain accurate scheduling records and proactively communicate appointment-related concerns to the provider.



2. Psychiatric Documentation and EHR Support



* Assist with preparing psychiatric intake and medication-management follow-up notes based on clinician-provided information.

* Organize clinical documentation using approved templates and established practice guidelines.

* Review administrative documentation queues and identify missing or incomplete notes.

* Notify the provider of outstanding documentation requiring clinical review or signature.

* Update EHR templates, intake forms, and administrative workflows as directed.

* Ensure documentation tasks are completed accurately and within established deadlines.

* Maintain clear tracking of pending and completed documentation tasks.



All clinical notes must be reviewed and approved by the licensed provider. The VA will not independently assess patients, make treatment decisions, or alter clinical findings.



3. Insurance Verification, Prior Authorizations, and Billing Support



* Verify patient insurance eligibility, benefits, copayments, deductibles, and coverage requirements.

* Complete administrative portions of medication prior authorization requests and follow up with pharmacies and insurance companies.

* Maintain a tracking system for pending, approved, and denied authorizations.

* Coordinate with the billing team regarding outstanding claims, payment discrepancies, and denials.

* Monitor unresolved billing issues and provide timely updates.

* Prepare monthly reports summarizing outstanding claims, denials, and follow-up actions.

* Escalate insurance or authorization issues that may affect patient access to treatment.



4. Patient Communication and Administrative Support



* Monitor designated practice
, phone, and messaging platforms during assigned hours.

* Respond to routine administrative questions using approved practice communication guidelines.

* Communicate professionally, respectfully, and compassionately with patients.

* Maintain organized records, spreadsheets, and administrative tracking systems.

* Coordinate referrals, medical records requests, and routine provider communications.

* Route clinical questions, medication concerns, urgent messages, and safety-related issues promptly to the appropriate licensed clinician according to established protocols.



5. Practice Organization and Daily Operations



* Maintain an organized daily task list with clear priorities and deadlines.

* Proactively identify outstanding tasks, upcoming deadlines, scheduling gaps, and administrative issues.

* Provide brief daily updates summarizing completed work, pending items, and matters requiring provider attention.

* Follow through on assigned tasks without repeated reminders.

* Communicate any delays, barriers, or questions as soon as they arise.

* Assist with developing and maintaining standard operating procedures (SOPs).

* Support administrative workflow improvements and practice growth initiatives.

* Assist with approved social media scheduling and basic marketing tasks when primary responsibilities are completed.



Required Qualifications



* Minimum 2 years of experience as a Medical Virtual Assistant or U.S. healthcare administrative professional.

* Strong preference for direct experience supporting psychiatrists, psychiatric nurse practitioners, therapists, or behavioral health practices.

* Experience with psychiatric documentation, medical scribing, or EHR chart preparation.

* Working knowledge of U.S. healthcare administration, insurance verification, and medication prior authorizations.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management.

* Ability to follow detailed instructions, retain established workflows, and work independently.

* Reliable communication and consistent follow-through.

* Comfortable receiving constructive feedback and applying it to future tasks.

* Strong computer skills and proficiency with spreadsheets,
, and online administrative systems.

* Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet private workspace, and appropriate equipment for secure remote work.

* Commitment to patient confidentiality, HIPAA-compliant procedures, required training, and applicable confidentiality or business associate agreements.



Preferred Software Experience



Direct experience with one or more of the following systems is highly preferred:



* OptiMantra – EHR and practice management

* SimplePractice – Telehealth and practice management

* Zocdoc – Patient bookings and intake coordination

* MDToolbox – Electronic prescribing and medication-related administrative workflows

* Headway – Patient intake, insurance, and billing coordination

* Spruce Health – Patient communication and messaging



Experience with psychiatric EHR systems, electronic prescribing workflows, medication prior authorizations, and insurance portals is a significant advantage.



Candidates should identify which platforms they have used and their level of proficiency.



Communication and Performance Expectations



We place significant importance on dependability, communication, and accountability.



The selected candidate must be able to:



* Communicate proactively instead of waiting to be asked for updates.

* Acknowledge assigned tasks and provide clear status updates.

* Consistently complete work within agreed-upon timeframes.

* Ask for clarification when instructions are unclear rather than making assumptions.

* Identify and report errors promptly.

* Demonstrate improvement after receiving feedback.

* Manage multiple administrative priorities effectively.

* Maintain professionalism and discretion when handling sensitive psychiatric patient information.

* Work independently while keeping the provider informed of important developments.



We value someone who is resourceful, organized, trustworthy, and genuinely invested in supporting a well-run practice.



Schedule and Compensation



* Remote, Philippines-based position

* Initially 15–20 hours per week

* Availability during agreed-upon U.S. Eastern Time business hours required

* Starting compensation: $4–$5 USD per hour, depending on qualifications and experience

* Potential for additional hours as the practice grows

* Long-term opportunity for the right candidate



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your updated résumé.

2. Years of experience working with U.S.-based medical or psychiatric practices.

3. A description of your psychiatric documentation or medical scribing experience.

4. The EHR systems and healthcare platforms you have used, specifically OptiMantra, SimplePractice, Zocdoc, MDToolbox, Headway, or Spruce.

5. Your experience with insurance verification, prior authorizations, and billing support.

6. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time and preferred weekly schedule.

7. Your desired hourly rate.

8. A brief description of how you organize daily responsibilities, manage deadlines, and communicate progress with providers.

9. A short video or audio introduction demonstrating your communication skills, if available.

10. Professional references from previous healthcare employers, if available.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid skills assessment using simulated patient information.



We look forward to connecting with qualified candidates interested in becoming a valued long-term member of our practice.

title: Sales & Procurement Coordinator
description:
About Q Engineering



Q Engineering is a Canadian engineering and building design consulting firm specializing in residential, commercial, industrial, institutional, and infrastructure projects. We provide integrated engineering and building design services, including architectural design, structural engineering, mechanical (HVAC), civil/grading, interior design, shop drawings, and permit coordination. Our multidisciplinary team works collaboratively to deliver innovative, practical, and code-compliant solutions from concept through permit approval and construction support.



Role Overview



As a Sales & Procurement Coordinator, you will support Q Engineering's business development, client relationship management, and procurement activities. This role is approximately 50% Sales and 50% Procurement & CRM, combining B2B sales outreach and CRM coordination with vendor, consultant, and procurement support.



You will be responsible for identifying and following up on potential business opportunities, maintaining accurate CRM records, supporting client communications, researching consultants and vendors, requesting and tracking quotations, maintaining vendor and partner information, and assisting with procurement documentation and comparisons.



This is a fully remote position requiring strong English communication, organization, online research skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently during Q Engineering's required Ontario working hours.



Key Responsibilities



Sales & CRM



Conduct B2B sales outreach and follow up with prospective and existing clients.

Research potential clients, markets, business opportunities, and industry contacts.

Support lead generation, prospecting, and business development activities.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date client, lead, and opportunity information in the CRM system.

Track sales activities, follow-ups, communications, and opportunity status.

Coordinate follow-up communications with prospective clients and business contacts.

Assist with preparing and organizing sales-related information, presentations, proposals, and supporting documentation.

Maintain organized records of client communications and business development activities.

Support management with sales pipeline tracking and CRM reporting.

Coordinate internally to ensure client inquiries and sales opportunities are followed up in a timely and professional manner.

Procurement & Vendor Coordination



Research qualified consultants, vendors, suppliers, and potential business partners based on project and operational requirements.

Request quotations and required information from consultants, vendors, and suppliers.

Follow up on outstanding quotations, information, and procurement documentation.

Maintain and update Q Engineering's consultant, vendor, supplier, and partner database.

Prepare organized quotation comparisons for management review.

Maintain RFQ tracking records, including request dates, responses, follow-ups, quotation status, and related documentation.

Collect and organize required procurement documents, qualifications, company information, and supporting records from potential consultants and vendors.

Assist with maintaining complete and accurate procurement records and supporting documentation.

Coordinate procurement-related communications and follow-ups with internal team members and external parties.

Support management in obtaining sufficient information and documentation for vendor and consultant evaluations.

Assist with other procurement and coordination activities as required.

Authority Limitation: The Sales & Procurement Coordinator supports procurement activities and provides research, coordination, documentation, and follow-up assistance. This position does not have authority to make final vendor or consultant selections, conduct or approve major negotiations, determine fees, approve commercial terms, or make commitments on behalf of Q Engineering without appropriate management approval.



Skills & Qualifications



Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related business field.

Education or background in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related technical field is considered an asset.

Previous experience in B2B sales, business development, sales coordination, procurement coordination, vendor management, CRM administration, or a related role.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Experience using CRM systems to maintain leads, contacts, opportunities, follow-ups, and sales records.

Experience with Zoho CRM is preferred but not mandatory.

Strong B2B prospecting, outreach, and follow-up skills.

Experience researching vendors, consultants, suppliers, prospective clients, or business opportunities online.

Ability to request, track, organize, and compare quotations and supporting documentation.

Strong organizational, administrative, and record-management skills.

Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple follow-ups, deadlines, and priorities.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office and cloud-based collaboration tools.

Ability to communicate professionally with clients, consultants, vendors, suppliers, and internal team members.

Ability to work independently, take initiative, and maintain productivity in a fully remote environment.

Engineering, construction, architecture, building design, or other technical industry experience is considered a preferred asset but is not mandatory.

Must be available to work during Q Engineering's required Ontario working hours.

Working Conditions



Hours of work: 40+ hours per week or as agreed in the engagement agreement.

Work Environment: Fully remote position using Microsoft Teams and cloudbased collaboration tools.

Special conditions or requirements: Reliable high-speed internet, professional home office, ability to maintain confidentiality, and availability during agreed working hours.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI): Q Engineering is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive professional environment.

Evaluation and Review: Performance will be evaluated based on drawing quality, technical accuracy, coordination, productivity, communication, and meeting agreed project deadlines.

Q Engineering – Professional Standards & Engagement Requirements



The Sales & Procurement Coordinator is expected to maintain accurate and organized sales, CRM, vendor, consultant, and procurement records while providing timely and professional coordination with clients, prospective clients, consultants, vendors, suppliers, and internal team members.



Individuals engaged in this role are expected to maintain high standards of professionalism, confidentiality, communication, accuracy, responsiveness, organization, and productivity while complying with Q Engineering's internal procedures and agreed-upon responsibilities. Procurement activities must be conducted within the authority assigned to the position, and final vendor or consultant selection, major negotiations, fee decisions, commercial commitments, and other binding decisions require appropriate management approval.

 and Instagram ads quickly, while they are still interested

- Research clubs online and build call lists (club name, owner name, phone,

- Answer basic questions from clubs about features and pricing, and pass harder questions to our team

description:
# NOW ACCEPTING APPLICATIONS: GoHighLevel Funnel & Automation Specialist



**Position:** GoHighLevel Funnel & Automation Specialist



**Job Type:** Remote | Part-Time / Project-Based Opportunity



**Compensation:** To Be Discussed During Interview



**Hiring Status:** Accepting Applications for an Upcoming Opportunity



### About the Opportunity



We are a growing beauty and education brand preparing to launch an exciting mentorship program designed to help beauty professionals grow, scale, and elevate their businesses.



As we prepare for this next chapter, we're looking to connect with a highly skilled, detail-oriented, and results-driven **GoHighLevel (GHL) Specialist** who can help us build the systems and infrastructure needed for a successful launch.



We're seeking someone who doesn't just understand GoHighLevel but knows how to strategically use it to generate leads, nurture potential clients, automate processes, and convert prospects into paying customers.



This is an upcoming opportunity, and we are currently reviewing applications to identify qualified candidates ahead of our official hiring phase.



### Key Responsibilities



- Design, build, and optimize high-converting sales funnels and landing pages within GoHighLevel.

- Develop lead generation funnels for waitlists, mentorship applications, and program enrollment.

- Set up automated
 and SMS marketing campaigns.

- Build lead nurturing sequences that guide prospects from initial interest to enrollment.

- Create and manage CRM pipelines, tags, triggers, workflows, and contact segmentation.

- Integrate forms, calendars, payment systems, and other necessary tools.

- Set up appointment booking, reminders, follow-ups, and onboarding automations.

- Track lead activity, funnel performance, conversion rates, and campaign results.

- Troubleshoot and optimize existing workflows and automations.

- Collaborate with our team to ensure all systems support our marketing and business goals.



### Qualifications



- Proven hands-on experience with GoHighLevel.

- Strong knowledge of sales funnels, CRM management, and marketing automation.

- Experience creating lead generation and conversion-focused systems.

- Experience building automated
 and SMS sequences.

- Understanding of customer journeys, lead nurturing, and sales conversion strategies.

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently.

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to meet deadlines.

- A proactive, solution-oriented mindset.



**Bonus Qualifications:**



- Experience supporting coaches, consultants, course creators, or mentorship programs.

- Experience with
 and Instagram lead generation campaigns.

- Knowledge of Meta Ads integrations, tracking pixels, and conversion tracking.

- Experience with webinar funnels, waitlists, and digital product launches.

- Ability to recommend improvements to increase lead conversion and reduce manual administrative work.



### What We're Looking For



We value individuals who take ownership of their work, communicate effectively, and genuinely understand how automation can help a business grow.



We're not simply looking for someone who can build a landing page. We're looking for someone who understands the bigger picture — how to create a seamless journey from a potential client's first interaction with our brand to becoming an enrolled mentorship client.



Creativity, strategic thinking, organization, and initiative are highly valued.

title: General Operations Analyst / Assistant Coach (Remote)
description:
General Operations Analyst / Assistant Coach



Location: Remote (Philippines preferred)

Schedule: Full-Time (40 hours/week), fixed shift

Timezone: Pacific Time (PT)

Type: Long-term, stable role



About the Role



We are hiring a Full-Time General Operations Analyst / Assistant Coach to support a fast-growing online fitness coaching business.



This is a broad, execution-focused role at the center of the business. You will support clients, keep our content pipeline on schedule, handle Instagram DM operations, and keep our data and systems accurate. The role combines:

-Client coaching support and client messaging

-Content operations, including our trial reel initiative

-Instagram DM operations and lead qualification

-Reporting, analytics, and systems

-Using AI tools to create and speed up work



The day will shift between priorities. Some parts of the shift are real-time (client messages, Instagram DMs, team requests on Slack), and the rest goes to coaching, content, and operations tasks.



This position is best suited for someone who is analytical, detail-oriented, strong with numbers, reliable with deadlines, and comfortable switching between tasks while following SOPs.



Key Responsibilities



Client Coaching Support & Messaging

-Respond to client messages and check-ins in a timely, professional way

-Update and manage client training programs and meal plans

-Calibrate clients' completed workouts and adjust weights and progressions based on our SOP

-Create weekly meal plans using templates, customized to each client's preferences

-Monitor client adherence, feedback, and progress, and flag issues early

-Keep all client data accurate in our coaching platform and internal trackers



Content Operations & Trial Reels

-Own our trial reel initiative from planning to delivery

-Manage the video editor so trial reels are delivered on time and to standard

-Track deadlines, follow up on anything late, and keep the content pipeline moving

-Schedule and post trial reels, and log what went live

-Track content performance and report what's working and what isn't



Instagram DM Operations & Lead Qualification

-Monitor and respond to inbound Instagram DMs during assigned hours

-Follow scripts and SOPs to nurture leads and manage follow-ups

-Qualify leads based on set criteria (goals, readiness, budget, etc.)

-Route qualified leads to the booking link / sales call

-Track DM metrics (response rate, qualified rate, booked calls)



Reporting, Analytics & Systems

-Maintain dashboards and reports in Google Sheets and Airtable

-Track and validate Meta ads data and funnel performance

-Run data QA so our numbers are accurate

-Support automations (Zapier, Make, CRM) and report anything broken

-Follow, update, and help write SOPs



AI-Assisted Work

-Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to draft SOPs, reports, scripts, and coaching materials

-Use AI to speed up analysis, summarize data, and find improvements

-Find new ways to automate or simplify repetitive work



General Operations

-Take on ad hoc projects and tasks as the business grows

-Communicate clearly with the team through Slack and attend Zoom check-ins with the Head of Operations



Important Notes

-This is a dedicated full-time role. During your scheduled shift, you must be fully present with us, not working another job or side project at the same time

-Real-time responsiveness is required during designated parts of the shift

-This is not a sales closing role

-All scripts, SOPs, systems, and templates are provided, and full training is given



Requirements

-Fluent English (written and spoken)

-Strong with numbers and basic calculations

-Analytical, organized, and process-driven

-Reliable with deadlines and comfortable following up with others to get work delivered

-Able to follow SOPs and switch tasks efficiently

-Comfortable with Instagram, Google Sheets, and structured workflows

-Available for a fixed shift in Pacific Time, 40 hours/week



Nice to Have (not required)

-Experience with fitness programming, meal planning, or online coaching

-Experience with DM setting, operations, or analytics

-Experience managing a freelancer, editor, or content schedule

-Experience with AI tools, Airtable, Zapier/Make, or coaching platforms like Everfit



What We Offer

-Full-time, stable remote position

-Clear systems, SOPs, and expectations

-Full training

-Long-term growth and leadership potential

-More responsibility as you perform



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:



1. A short video introduction about yourself (provide me a sharable google drive link)

2. Your experience with operations, analytics, client support, content, DM-based work, or fitness-related tasks

3. Tools you've used (Instagram, Google Sheets, Airtable, CRMs, AI tools, etc.)

4. One example of something you created or sped up using AI

5. Do you currently have any other job or ongoing projects? If yes, what are the hours?

6. Your expected monthly compensation



Only applicants who follow instructions and can commit to a full-time, fixed schedule will be considered.



Best,

Jeffrey Chi
